targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1h') time,count(*) value FROM interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT status metric,count(*) value FROM interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY status
SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1h') time,avg(total_ms) avg_ms,percentile_cont(.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) p95_ms FROM interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1h') time,avg(retrieval_ms) retrieval_ms,avg(llm_ms) llm_ms FROM interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1h') time,sum(input_tokens) input,sum(output_tokens) output FROM interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT coalesce(sum(estimated_cost_usd),0) value FROM interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT CASE feedback WHEN 1 THEN 'positive' WHEN -1 THEN 'negative' ELSE 'none' END metric,count(*) value FROM interactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY feedback
